name: Componentry
summary: Animated React UI components — text effects, hero backgrounds, cursor and scroll effects — installed with the shadcn CLI.
description: 53 animated, copy-paste React components built with Tailwind CSS and Framer Motion, grouped into text animations, components, hero backgrounds, visual effects and ASCII effects. Includes kinetic text, WebGL cursor effects, carousels, cards and calendars; install via the shadcn CLI or an AI editor over MCP.
contains: 53 components: text animations, hero backgrounds, visual effects, ASCII effects
install via shadcn CLI or MCP; source is editable
docs page per component with previews
